doc.section: Story 3.4: Leaf-Only and Double-Entry Validation Engine

docs.doc: Story definition: As a user, I want the system to enforce leaf-only and double-entry checks on all vouchers, so that input errors are prevented and compliance is assured. Acceptance criteria cover leaf-only validation, BigDecimal double-entry, negative amount blocking, required dimensions, and bulk validation.

VoucherValidationService reuse: Story 3.3 reused VoucherValidationService from Story 3.2 for bulk validation before posting. Field-level error map format established: { error: { code, message, details: { lines: { [lineNumber]: { [field]: [errors] } } } }, meta: {...} }. Bulk validation pattern collects all errors before returning.

SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId() created to eliminate duplication. Audit logging patterns established for posting, unposting, and reversal operations. Company scoping pattern via CompanyScopeAspect. RBAC enforcement using @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT','ADMIN','CFO')").

Chart of Accounts: chart_of_accounts (id, code, name, type, parent_id, company_id, postable, ...). Hierarchical structure (3 levels: 1xx, 11x, 111). Transactions: vouchers, voucher_lines, journal_entries tables.
RBAC enforcement at API level. Company isolation via company_id filtering. Role-based access: Accountant, Chief Accountant, Admin, CFO.

artifact.reason: Service interface for voucher validation. Story 3.4 will enhance this service with leaf-only validation, BigDecimal double-entry validation, negative amount blocking, and required dimension validation.

Current implementation validates double-entry balance, checks account existence, and validates dimension requirements using hardcoded account code patterns (131, 331, 154, 621). Story 3.4 will enhance with leaf-only validation (check postable=true), BigDecimal rounding logic, negative amount blocking, and company/config-driven dimension validation via account_controls table.
Uses VoucherValidationService for bulk validation before posting. Story 3.4 will ensure BigDecimal double-entry validation with HALF_UP rounding is enforced here.
Builds field-level error map format: { lines: { [lineNumber]: { [field]: [errors] } } }. Story 3.4 should reuse this format for all validation errors.
Utility method for extracting current user ID. Story 3.4 should reuse this for fraud detection logging.
Account picker component with isLeaf property check. Story 3.4 will enhance to disable non-postable accounts (check postable=true flag) and add visual indicators for disabled accounts.

Voucher line item grid component with inline validation. Story 3.4 will enhance for real-time validation feedback: leaf-only accounts, negative amounts, required dimensions with inline error indicators.

Voucher form page component. Story 3.4 will enhance for bulk validation display: validation summary panel showing all errors at once, field-level errors grouped by line number, validation status badge, disable Post button if validation fails.

REST API controller for voucher operations. Story 3.4 will ensure POST /api/v1/vouchers blocks non-leaf accounts with 400 Bad Request, POST /api/v1/vouchers/{id}/post validates BigDecimal double-entry, and API blocks negative amounts.

Unit tests for VoucherValidationService. Story 3.4 will add tests for leaf-only validation, BigDecimal double-entry validation with rounding, negative amount blocking, required dimension validation, and bulk validation error collection.

story-context.constraints: - Leaf-only account validation: Only accounts with postable=true and no child accounts can be used for posting. Parent accounts (summary accounts) cannot be used. - BigDecimal precision: 19 digits, scale: 2 decimal places. All amount calculations must use BigDecimal (not double or float). - Rounding mode: HALF_UP for double-entry balance checks. Rounding logic must be documented in code comments explaining why HALF_UP is used. - Negative amount blocking: Negative debit or credit values must be blocked at both UI and API level. Attempts must be logged as "possible fraud" event. - Required dimension validation: Company/config-driven via account_controls table. Validation must check account_controls table for company and account combination. - Bulk validation: Validate all voucher lines and collect all errors before returning. All errors must be returned at once in field-level error map format (not sequentially). - Field-level error map format: { error: { code, message, details: { lines: { [lineNumber]: { [field]: [errors] } } } }, meta: {...} } - Company scoping: All operations use CompanyScopeAspect for automatic company filtering. Account controls are company-scoped. - RBAC enforcement: Account control management requires Chief Accountant+ role (@PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole('CHIEF_ACCOUNTANT','ADMIN','CFO')")). Accountant role can view but not modify account controls. - Audit logging: All blocked attempts (non-postable accounts, negative amounts) must be logged in audit trail. Fraud detection events must include user ID, role, timestamp, voucher ID, line number, account code, attempted amount, and IP address. - Transaction management: Validation is read-only, no transaction needed. Fraud detection logging should be transactional to ensure audit trail integrity. - Database migration: Create Flyway migration for account_controls table (V30__create_account_controls.sql) with unique constraint on (account_id, company_id) and indexes for query performance.

tests.standards: Unit tests use JUnit 5 and Mockito. Integration tests use @SpringBootTest with IntegrationTest base class and TestContainers for PostgreSQL. Frontend tests use Vitest, Testing Library, and jsdom. Coverage targets: 70% for backend business logic, 60% for frontend components. All validation errors must be tested with field-level error map format. Test both single-line and multi-line validation paths.
tests.locations: Backend unit tests: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/service/impl/voucher/ Backend integration tests: backend/src/test/java/com/accounting/controller/voucher/ Frontend unit tests: frontend/src/**/*.test.tsx, frontend/src/**/*.test.ts QA test cases: docs/sprint-artifacts/ (manual test scenarios)

test.description: Test leaf-only validation: block parent accounts (postable=false) in VoucherValidationService. Test AccountPicker disables non-postable accounts. Test API returns 400 Bad Request with detailed error when non-leaf account selected. Test audit log entry created for blocked attempt.

Test BigDecimal double-entry validation: verify Total Debit equals Total Credit using BigDecimal.compareTo() with HALF_UP rounding. Test rounding edge cases (0.005 rounding, precision limits). Test rounding logic documented in code comments. Test validation allows small rounding differences (0.01 VND tolerance) if needed.

Test negative amount blocking: verify UI blocks negative debit/credit values in MoneyInput. Test API returns 400 Bad Request when negative amount detected. Test fraud detection logging: verify 'possible fraud' event logged with user ID, role, timestamp, voucher ID, line number, account code, attempted amount, IP address. Test admin alert log entry created (email deferred).

Test required dimension validation: verify account_controls table lookup for company and account combination. Test validation checks requires_customer, requires_supplier, requires_cost_center flags. Test all validation errors shown at once (bulk validation). Test Account Control Management UI: Chief Accountant+ can configure required dimensions, Accountant can view but not modify.

Test bulk validation: verify all voucher lines validated before returning. Test all errors returned at once in field-level error map format. Test single-line validation errors. Test multi-line validation errors. Test field-level errors properly mapped to line numbers and field names. Test QA test cases cover both single-line and multi-line validation paths.

Integration test: POST /api/v1/vouchers with non-leaf account returns 400 with field-level error. POST /api/v1/vouchers/{id}/post with Dr≠Cr returns 400 with balance error. POST /api/v1/vouchers with negative amount returns 400 with fraud detection log. POST /api/v1/vouchers with missing required dimension returns 400 with all errors at once.

Frontend test: AccountPicker filters out non-postable accounts from options. AccountPicker shows disabled state and tooltip for non-postable accounts. VoucherLineGrid displays inline error indicators for leaf-only, negative amount, required dimension violations. VoucherFormPage shows validation summary panel with all errors grouped by line number.
